claims.proposition: Write off all or part of a financial asset when no reasonable expectation of recovery remains; the allowance and gross receivable move together.
claims.effective_period: 2026 issued edition; select historical edition for older periods
claims.entity_scope: For-profit; apply entity-tier and jurisdiction overlay
limitations: Only the identified core route has been inspected; subsidiary claims require separate audit.

claims.proposition: Apply Australian financial instrument impairment/write-off model after selecting the operative AASB 9 compilation.
claims.entity_scope: For-profit; apply entity-tier and jurisdiction overlay
limitations: AASB 9 period-specific compilation and paragraph must be audited.

claims.proposition: Apply the applicable FRS 102 Section 23 revenue and/or Section 11 financial instrument model; do not transplant IFRS 9 expected-loss mechanics.
claims.effective_period: Revised Section 23 generally annual starts from 1 January 2026; Section 11 version must be checked
claims.entity_scope: For-profit; apply entity-tier and jurisdiction overlay
limitations: Exact operative paragraph and election/transition remain to be audited.

claims.proposition: Apply the relevant US Topic 606, ASC 326 and/or ASC 340-40 route independently of IFRS; exact method depends on transaction and operative Codification.

limitations: Current Codification paragraph not inspected; do not infer US rules from IFRS.
